purpose: Teach: パーカー/出前/おとり/真っ青/ガット/月々/街路/ソープ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、パーカー、絶対、お洒落だよね
lines.en: Riku, your hoodie is actually so stylish.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration with a light tease underneath. Open vowels, easy rhythm. Not trying too hard — just noticing something nice and saying it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試験勉強の合間、本気で、絶対、出前、絶対、お寿司、絶対、頼んだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, seriously — between exam cramming sessions I ordered us sushi delivery, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, conspiratorial energy. A small proud smile in the delivery — he did something nice and knows she'll get it. Matter-of-fact about the extravagance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 警察ドラマで、本気で、絶対、おとり、絶対、捜査、絶対、面白いよね、リク
lines.en: Police dramas are actually kind of fascinating though, right? The undercover operations and stuff.
lines.style: Thoughtful, less performative. She's genuinely interested, turning an observation into a real question. Softer attack than her teasing mode. Inviting him to agree.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験結果見て、本気で、絶対、真っ青、絶対、になっちゃったぜ、桜
lines.en: When I saw the test results I went completely pale, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating. A wry smile at his own shock. Not dwelling on it — moving past the moment with humor. Steady, unflustered delivery despite the content.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の、本気で、絶対、ラケット、絶対、ガット、絶対、張り替えしたよ、リク
lines.en: I restrung the racket strings at club practice today, Riku.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. Practical information stated without fanfare. Simple, capable tone — just what needed doing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: スマホの、本気で、絶対、月々、絶対、料金、絶対、高いよな、桜
lines.en: Phone bills really are expensive every month though, aren't they, Sakura.
lines.style: A note of mild complaint, genuinely felt but not heavy. Conversational observation more than gripe. Small sigh in the middle, like he's thinking it through as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 通学路の、本気で、絶対、街路、絶対、樹、絶対、紅葉、絶対、綺麗だよね、リク
lines.en: The trees along our school route are really beautiful right now with the autumn colors.
lines.style: Gentle, wistful noticing. She's caught something small and pretty and wants to mark it. Warm vowels, unhurried pace. A moment of quiet appreciation offered.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、固形、絶対、ソープ、絶対、置いてあったぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandma actually had this bar of solid soap sitting in her bathroom, Sakura.
lines.style: Amused, slightly bemused observation. He's noticed something small and oddly charming about his grandma's house. Conversational, warm — not mocking, just sharing something real.
